findings.text: the new public root /analysis/src/ofmcauto does not exist on the host (verified 2026-10-06 through the jt-60sa hop: `ls -d /analysis/src/ofmcauto` returns 'No such file or directory'; the other ten named subdirectories are real directories, not symlinks). The node already flagged this in its own follow_ons; recorded here as confirmed against the host rather than inferred.

the run's evidence record is thinner than the artifact it describes. The manifest names test_logs but records baseline_suite and after_suite as absent, and the evidence fragment reports only the clean summary lines (scanned=11, scored=0 cost) while the run log it cites (paths_jt-60sa.log) also shows repeated 'LLM failed after 5 attempts ... TriageBatch/ScoreBatch Invalid JSON' with 'Reverting to scanned status for retry', 'Skipped 3/3 failed scores (not written to graph)', an 'LLM possible stall' warning, and a worker-initiated graceful shutdown (SIGINT) at 06:48:46 that ended the run 6m 10s into a nominal 20-minute window. The plan's own measure (scored rows under each tree) is met and the manifest honestly records the SIGINT, but the fragment does not surface that many rows remain scanned/skipped because the local seats returned malformed JSON, so a reader of the fragment alone would not know the run was partial.

justifications.durability: the change is committed and the graph state it claims is reproduced live, so the outcome persists. Docked because nothing guards the new root list: tests/config/test_facility_config_compliance.py validates schema, unknown keys, enums and required fields but asserts nothing about the specific root set, so a later edit could silently reintroduce /analysis/src or drop one of the eleven subdirectories with no test going red, and the run itself left many rows at scanned/skipped on failed local-seat JSON rather than a durable terminal state.
justifications.evidence: independent verification is strong where it was possible: the live graph reproduces every headline number in the fragment exactly, the jt-60sa hop answers intr26-2 through the ssh wrapper, host ls confirms 10 of 11 named directories exist as real directories, and the facility-config compliance gate passes at base (29/29) and over the reviewed config set. Docked because the run's manifest records no baseline_suite/after_suite arms, the fragment's negative control is a post-hoc count (exact /analysis/src = 0) rather than a red log, and the fragment does not surface the run's malformed-JSON LLM failures and worker SIGINT that the log it cites plainly shows.
justifications.fit: the YAML edit keeps the file's existing root list and comment convention and adds a two-line comment stating the mechanism (a seed of the parent creates a depth-0 row that walks every unseeded child), which is exactly the reason the parent was removed; the evidence fragment follows the docs/evidence/fragments/<topic>/ convention and carries no plan label in its filename or content.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the delta delivers the §14 paths-node goal precisely: the public discovery_roots no longer names /analysis/src (verified by parsing the reviewed YAML: 18 roots, '/analysis/src' exact absent) and names its eleven children with the concrete spellings the private config already uses, so the seed no longer creates the never-scanned parent row the plan set out to remove; the scoped run then produced the plan's measured outcome (scored rows under each of the three equilibrium trees, spend $0.000). Docked because the operational run is partial (see evidence) and, on the plan's wider §14 done-when, the code-chunk half belongs to the still-in-flight code-run node rather than this node.
justifications.reuse: the node introduced no new code — it reuses the existing seed mechanism and simply supplies the correct root set, and it adopts the concrete directory spellings already present in jt-60sa_private.yaml rather than inventing new ones; the run reuses the existing discover paths pipeline with --root scoping, so nothing is duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 1c81b71ab..2cac8db69 touches exactly two paths, both inside the manifest's declared write_paths; no schema, no private YAML, no plan and no shared index is modified. Both commits carry a conventional subject and a body, neither carries an AI trailer, and neither names a plan, sprint or ticket identifier.
